_comment: Camera bus registry. Generate entries with `uv run python -m hardware.bench.cameras discover` on cell1 (plug the camera in first), then fill in name + location. path MUST be a /dev/v4l/by-path entry — it encodes the physical hub port, which is what stays stable across reboots (the ELP boards all share one USB serial). solo = full-res view + interval stills; tile = the reduced profile the 3x3 view uses. still_interval_s 0 disables interval capture for that camera.

cameras.name: bench
cameras.location: wall bracket, 60 deg down over the arm
cameras.notes: ELP-USBFHD01M-L36, 3.6mm, first camera of the fleet
